scope: Selected variants only; no whole-suite coverage claim. Each supported variant runs in an isolated native process. Synchronous and Promise-job asynchronous Scripts use parsed strictness and unchanged harness sources. Parse/early-negative tests use native syntax validation without evaluation. Unsupported module execution, agents, lowering and runtime operations, as well as harness errors, crashes and timeouts remain in the totals. Module and Script-root dynamic imports use checked referrer views and a lazy sibling table loader. JSON is parsed natively at load and exposes one default export; type attributes are checked before cached records are used. Unresolved bare specifiers reject their import promises with TypeError. Source modules support top-level await and direct eval. Text/bytes, source/defer phases, undiscovered relative specifiers and runtime compilation of loaded modules remain unsupported. Native fixture syntax and early-error checks remain lazy at load.
variantPolicy: All syntaxVariants from tools/test262.ts; raw/strict/sloppy/module flags retained; fixture files excluded. No unsupported or failed variants excluded from the denominator.

compilation.failurePolicy: A failed batch compilation is retained for every affected variant; no automatic retry.
